Mādhavācārya
(c. 1297-1386 A. D.). or Mādhavāmātya of Bhāradvājagotra, Bodhāyana Sūtra; son of Māyaṇa an. Sukīrti (Śrīmati); disciple of Viṣṇusarvajña, brother of Sāyaṇa an. Bhoganātha a. known from the inscription a. Amḷāḷa Perumāḷ temple a. Kāñcīpuram; disciple of Vidyātīrtha, Bhāratītīrtha an. Śrīkaṇṭha; preceptor of Keśava (a. of C. Bhāṣya on Nārāyaṇopaniṣad, RASB. II. 477); known a. minister of Bukkaṇa or Bukka I. Traditionally believed to be identical with Vidyāraṇya (fourthāśrama name) an. also Bhāratītīrtha; different from Mādhavamantrin, who belonged to Āṅgīrasa-gotra an. was son of Cauṇḍa or Cauṇḍibhaṭṭa an. Mācāmbikā.
Many works written by Sāyaṇa are attributed to this author.
For a detailed note on the a., see Kane, HDS. I. ii. Sn. 93; also D.. M. Kripacharyalu, Sāyaṇa an. Mādhava Vidyāraṇya : A study of their lives an. letters, Rajyalakshmi Publications, Guntur, 1986.
